title: Using mechanical homogenization to isolate microglia from mouse brain tissue to preserve transcriptomic integrity
protocol: Perfuse adult mouse transcardially with 20 mL of ice-cold HBSS.
Dissect entire brain or region of interest with razor blades on ice.
Keep dissected tissue in ice-cold HBSS until homogenization.
Chop the brain once or twice sagittally and 3–4 times coronally.
Remove the cerebellum if required for the specific experiment.
Transfer entire contents of one brain into HBSS in a clean ice-cold Dounce homogenizer pre-rinsed with ice-cold HBSS.
Gently begin to homogenize the brain tissue using pestle A.
Push down on the tissue with the pestle until brain tissue is slightly expelled up and around the sides of the pestle foot and between the wall of the homogenizer.
Gently twist the pestle to separate the expelled tissue from the rest of the brain tissue.
Begin homogenization with pestle A gently and slowly until all remaining chunks can bypass the foot of pestle A upon depression and retraction with minimal resistance.
Proceed to homogenize with pestle B once the mixture reaches consistency similar to the reference image shown in Figure 1A.
Apply slow, even strokes with pestle B during homogenization to avoid excessive shear force that could destroy microglia.
Homogenize with pestle B until barely any visible chunks remain.
Rinse the homogenizer with ice-cold HBSS (7 mL) and perform five slow passes with both pestles A and B.
Add the contents of this wash step to the tube containing the homogenization mixture.
If interested in analyzing a homogeneous mixture, take 500 μL, centrifuge to pellet the cells, and snap freeze for downstream applications.
Rinse the homogenizer again with 7 mL ice-cold HBSS and apply vigorous strokes (10 times) with both pestles A and B.
Discard the HBSS after ensuring no stuck cells remain in the homogenizer.
Repeat the homogenization process for the remaining brains.
Pellet the mixture by centrifuging at 350 g at 4°C for 5 min.
Prepare Falcon tubes equal to the number of samples by adding 5 mL of 70% Percoll.
Remove supernatant from tubes after centrifugation, taking care not to disturb the pellet.
Re-suspend the homogenized pellet in 5 mL of 37% Percoll solution.
Ensure thorough resuspension without destroying cells by pipetting.
Slowly and carefully layer the 37% Percoll resuspension on top of the 70% Percoll layer.
Add 7.5 mM sterile NaOH to achieve a concentration of 1.25 mg/ml.
Hold the tube containing the 70% Percoll at an initial angle of 65° when adding the first milliliter of the 37% layer using a pipette with gravity setting.
Adjust the tube's angle to vertical (90°) as more 37% Percoll is added.
Place samples in a centrifuge set to 23°C, at 800 g for 25 minutes with acceleration level 3 and brake level 1.
Immediately lower the centrifuge temperature to 4°C after removing tubes carefully without disturbing the interphase layer.
Prepare Falcon 15-mL tubes by filling them with 8 ml of FACS buffer while samples are spinning.
Collect between 2 to 3 ml of the interphase layer using a P1000 pipette and transfer into appropriately labeled Falcon 15-mL tubes containing FACS buffer.
Pellet the cells by centrifuging at 4°C, 350 g for 5 min.
Aspirate or remove all but 300 μL of liquid from the Falcon 15-mL tubes and re-suspend the pellet.
Agitate all sides of the bottom of the Falcon 15-mL tubes with at least 10 pumps of a P1000 for subsequent resuspension steps.
Create a master-mix of CD11b-PEcy7, Ly6C-PercpCy5.5 and LIVE/DEAD UV Stain at a concentration of 1:150 for each antibody/dye in FACS buffer.
Add 300 μL of staining master mix to each Falcon 15 tube containing the re-suspended pellet of myeloid cells.
Leave the tubes on ice, covered from light for 15 min.
Fill the Falcon 15-mL tubes with 8 mL ice-cold FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 4°C, 350 g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant, leaving only 2-300 μL remaining in the tube.
Re-suspend the pellet.
Transfer the re-suspended cell solution from the Falcon 15-mL tubes to the filter cap FACS sorting tubes using a P1000.
Fill a FACS collection tube with 300 μL of ice hold HBSS.
Isolate singlet LIVE/dead negative, Ly6C negative, CD11b positive cells using a cell sorter.
